mapper.select: SELECT file_id,create_time FROM t_file_object WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND creation_source='UPLOAD'
mapper.sql: upload_id,tenant_id,uploader_id,source_system,reason_code,display_name,expected_size,expected_mime,storage_provider, storage_container_ref AS container_ref,storage_object_ref AS object_ref,scan_policy_id,expires_time AS expires_at,status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_file_upload WHERE upload_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId,f.source_system AS sourceSystem,f.reason_code AS reasonCode,u.display_name AS displayName, f.mime_type AS mimeType,f.size_bytes AS sizeBytes,f.content_hash AS contentHash,f.scan_status AS scanStatus, f.object_status AS objectStatus,u.uploader_id AS uploaderId,f.create_time AS createTime FROM t_file_object f LEFT JOIN t_file_upload u ON u.upload_id=f.upload_id WHERE f.file_id=#{fileId}

SELECT r.requirement_id AS id,r.scanner_code,r.scan_type AS type,r.minimum_scanner_version AS minimum_version, r.accepted_result_codes AS accepted_codes,s.result_code FROM t_file_scan_requirement r JOIN t_file_scan_policy p ON p.policy_id=r.policy_id LEFT JOIN t_file_scan_result s ON s.file_id=#{fileId} AND s.scan_requirement_id=r.requirement_id AND s.scan_policy_id=r.policy_id AND s.attempt_no=1 WHERE r.policy_id=#{policyId} ORDER BY r.requirement_no
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET status='COMPLETED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING') AND expires_time > #{now}
UPDATE t_file_object SET scan_status=#{status},available_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='AVAILABLE' THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE file_id=#{id}
